verdict.rationale: The manual documents search that matches filenames, symbols, line numbers and text content, with fuzzy matching for filenames and symbols. It also supports regular-expression search by wrapping a pattern in slashes. Regex is documented only for the 'file scope', and filters are implied by search scopes rather than described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of search filters, regex beyond the file scope (e.g. repository-wide), independent or hands-on corroboration.
